free_design.Place: At the end of a bicycle repair ramp in an orbital station, where an observation window overlooks a quiet field of satellites.
free_design.Activity: She tests the restored brass bicycle bell by flicking its lever just before fastening it to the handlebar.
free_design.Pose: Standing nearly front-on, she holds the small bell out in her left palm and touches the lever with her right index finger.
free_design.Framing: Vertical upper-thigh framing with soft overcast illumination in the workshop and both hands clearly visible.
free_design.Outfit: A contrasting lemon-and-slate clipped knit halter with an asymmetric low neckline, worn with brick-red paperbag-waist cycling shorts and black low-top trainers.
